operation_notes.parse: build a tree from the XML string, discard it
operation_notes.iterparse: stream every record element and discard it; needs a uniformly repeated tag
operation_notes.dict_convert: XML string in, plain dict out (same @attr/#text convention both sides)
operation_notes.dict_stream: same dict conversion, streamed one record at a time; needs a uniformly repeated tag
operation_notes.to_object: XML string in, lazy attribute-style object out
operation_notes.xml_to_json: XML string in, JSON string out, end to end
operation_notes.xml_to_jsonl: XML in, one JSON object per record out (JSON Lines); needs a uniformly repeated tag

pygixml.name: pygixml
pygixml.capability: dom, streaming iterparse, objectify, dictify, jsonify, cli

yq.name: yq
yq.capability: cli: jq-style query/convert (installs the `xq` XML binary used below)

elementtree.name: elementtree
elementtree.note: Python standard library -- always present, nothing to install

cli.metric: best (min) wall-clock seconds over repeats, process startup included
